proof_body:
by
  intro A B C h
  have h1 : A + B = Real.pi - C := by linarith
  have h2 : (A + B) / 2 = Real.pi / 2 - C / 2 := by rw [h1]; ring
  rw [h2, h1]
  exact ⟨Real.sin_pi_sub C, Real.cos_pi_sub C, Real.sin_pi_div_two_sub _, Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub _⟩
target_source: ∀ A B C : ℝ, A + B + C = Real.pi → Real.sin (A + B) = Real.sin C ∧ Real.cos (A + B) = -Real.cos C ∧ Real.sin ((A + B) / 2) = Real.cos (C / 2) ∧ Real.cos ((A + B) / 2) = Real.sin (C / 2)
